f.title: Know the ACNU key elements, since a failure to implement one is an ACNU failure
f.statement: The key elements of an ACNU described in an NDA are: the additional condition the applicant implements and the consumer must fulfil to obtain the product; the labeling specifically associated with the ACNU; and the criteria by which the consumer successfully fulfils the ACNU, including the specific actions or required responses of the consumer. A failure associated with implementing any of them is an ACNU failure under 314.81(b)(3)(v)(A)(1).
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU

(iv) A description of the key elements of the ACNU, including:
 (A) The additional condition implemented by the applicant to be 
fulfilled by the consumer to obtain the nonprescription drug product 
with an ACNU;
 (B) The labeling specifically associated with the ACNU; and
 (C) The criteria by which the consumer would successfully fulfill 
the ACNU, including a description of the specific actions to be taken 
by a consumer or required responses to be provided by a consumer;

f.title: Treat a failure of an ACNU key element or of its operationalization as a reportable ACNU failure
f.statement: An ACNU failure occurs on either of two events: a failure associated with the implementation of a key element of the ACNU (314.56(c)(1)(iv) or (c)(2)(ii)), or a failure associated with the operationalization of the ACNU (314.56(c)(1)(vii) or (c)(2)(iii)).
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(A) ACNU failure as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU
rows.quote:
(A) 
ACNU failure. An ACNU failure occurs upon either of the following 
events:
 (1) A failure associated with the implementation of a key element 
of an ACNU under Sec. 314.56(c)(1)(iv) or (c)(2)(ii); or
 (2) A failure associated with the operationalization of an ACNU 
under Sec. 314.56(c)(1)(vii) or (c)(2)(iii).
rows.location: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(A) ACNU failure as added by amendment 6

f.title: Write procedures for surveillance, receipt, evaluation and reporting of ACNU failures
f.statement: The applicant must develop written procedures for the surveillance, receipt, evaluation and reporting to FDA of ACNU failures.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(B) Review of ACNU failure as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.processes: Safety governance; Quality system & CAPA; Safety intake & collection
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU
rows.quote:
(B) Review of ACNU failure. The applicant must develop written 
procedures for the surveillance, receipt, evaluation, and reporting of 
ACNU failures to FDA.

f.title: Report an adverse drug experience linked to an ACNU failure as one ICSR describing both
f.statement: If the applicant receives or otherwise obtains information on an adverse drug experience associated with an ACNU failure before it has submitted a report of that ACNU failure, it must submit an individual case safety report (ICSR) describing both the adverse drug experience and the associated ACNU failure, containing the information required in 314.80(f) and the information required in paragraph (b)(3)(v)(A).
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(C) Report of ACNU failure as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU
rows.quote:
(C) Report of ACNU failure. If an applicant receives or otherwise 
obtains information regarding an adverse drug experience associated 
with an ACNU failure before the submission of a report of an ACNU 
failure, an applicant must submit a report in the form of an individual 
case safety report (ICSR) that describes both the adverse drug 
experience and the associated ACNU failure. The ICSR must contain the 
information required in Sec. 314.80(f) and paragraph (b)(3)(v)(A) of 
this section.
rows.location: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(C) Report of ACNU failure as added by amendment 6

f.title: Follow up an ACNU-failure-only report or an ADE-only ICSR when the associated event becomes known
f.statement: If a previously submitted ACNU failure report covered only the ACNU failure, or a previously submitted ICSR covered only the adverse drug experience, and the applicant later receives or otherwise obtains information on the associated adverse drug experience or ACNU failure, it must submit a follow-up report to the earlier report with the new information, including the information required by 314.80(f) or (b)(3)(v)(A) as applicable.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(C) Report of ACNU failure as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU
rows.quote:

follow up report to the previously submitted report with the new 
information. The follow-up report must include the information required 
in Sec. 314.80(f) or paragraph (b)(3)(v)(A) of this section, as 
applicable.

f.title: Include the minimum ACNU failure report content: applicant contact, identifiable reporter, product name and failure description
f.statement: Every ACNU failure report must include the name, address, email and telephone number of the applicant; an identifiable reporter; the drug product name; and a description of the ACNU failure.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(D)(1) Content of report, Required information as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

f.title: Add product, reporter, case ID, failure term and dates to the ACNU failure report when known
f.statement: The ACNU failure report must also include, if known: drug product strength, NDC, lot number and NDA or ANDA number; initial reporter name, address and telephone number; a unique case identification number that is the same in the initial and any follow-up report; the ACNU failure term(s); the date of the ACNU failure (or best estimate); and the date the failure was reported to the applicant.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(D)(2)(i)-(vi) Content of report, Additional information as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

f.title: Add failure location, narrative, remedial and corrective action to the ACNU failure report when known
f.statement: The ACNU failure report must also include, if known: the location of the failure with business name and contact information; a concise narrative that states whether the consumer accessed or used the product without successfully fulfilling the ACNU, fulfilled the ACNU but could not access or use the product, or was unable to attempt to fulfill the ACNU; a description of the remedial action initiated or completed, with its type (for example repair, replace, recall, inspection, modification or adjustment); and a description of the corrective action to prevent recurrence of an ACNU failure of the same nature.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(D)(2)(vii)-(x) Content of report, Additional information as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

rows.actor: Applicant (NDA or ANDA holder) of a nonprescription drug product with an ACNU
rows.quote:
(vii) Location of the ACNU failure, including business name and 
contact information.
 (viii) Concise narrative summary of the ACNU failure including 
whether any of the following circumstances occurred: the consumer 
accessed or used the drug product without successfully fulfilling the 
ACNU; the consumer successfully fulfilled the ACNU but could not access 
or use the drug product; or the consumer was unable to make an attempt 
to fulfill the ACNU.
 (ix) Description of the remedial action initiated or completed to 
address the ACNU failure, including the type of remedial action 
initiated or completed (for example, repair, replace, recall, 
inspection, modification, or adjustment).
 (x) Description of the corrective action to prevent reoccurrence of 
an ACNU failure of the same nature.
rows.location: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(D)(2)(vii)-(x) Content of report, Additional information as added by amendment 6

f.title: Submit ACNU failure reports within 15 calendar days of acquiring the minimum dataset
f.statement: The applicant must submit the report of an ACNU failure as soon as possible and no later than 15 calendar days from the date it acquired the minimum dataset for the ACNU failure.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(E)(1) Submission as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

f.title: Investigate new information on a submitted ACNU failure report and assess its impact
f.statement: The applicant must investigate any new information it receives or otherwise obtains about a previously submitted ACNU failure report and assess the relationship or impact of that information on the initial report.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(E)(2) Submission as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)
f.change_summary: Adds 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v), not in the CFR 4-1-25 edition used for the 314.81 curation.

f.title: Submit ACNU failure follow-up reports within 15 calendar days of obtaining new information
f.statement: The applicant must submit any follow-up report of an ACNU failure as soon as possible and no later than 15 calendar days after obtaining the new information.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(E)(2) Submission as added by amendment 6

f.title: Submit ACNU failure reports electronically as required by 314.80(g)
f.statement: Reports of ACNU failure must be submitted to FDA in the electronic format required by 314.80(g).
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(F)(1) Electronic format for submissions as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)

f.statement: An applicant may request, in writing, a waiver of the electronic format requirement for ACNU failure reports, in accordance with 314.90 or 314.99.

f.title: Keep records of all ACNU failure reports and associated adverse drug experiences for 10 years
f.statement: The applicant must keep, for 10 years, the records of all reports of ACNU failures and associated adverse drug experiences known to it, including raw data and any correspondence relating to an ACNU failure report.
f.clause: 21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(v)(G) Recordkeeping as added by amendment 6
f.applicability: Nonprescription drug products with an additional condition for nonprescription use (ACNU) approved under an NDA or ANDA (21 CFR 314.56)

dates.title: ACNU final rule (89 FR 105288): effective date as published

dates.quote: DATES: This rule is effective January 27, 2025.
